purpose: Qualified Mortgage points-and-fees test per Reg Z §1026.43(e)(3). Applies version-pinned 2021-2026 tier table with Federal Register citations. Covers five tiers: 3% for loans over tier-1 minimum, fixed dollar amounts for mid-range loans, 5% and 8% for smaller loans. Agents hallucinate current-year thresholds; this node supplies authoritative version-pinned values.
